entry.title: Build specialized multimodal models with LFM3
entry.summary:
Liquid AI has introduced LFM3, a framework for building specialized, context-aware multimodal models fine-tuned on custom visual and text datasets.

Why it matters: It enables developers to deploy highly specialized multimodal models optimized for specific enterprise domains with lower compute overhead.
